Jamie: Quick sync — opened a small PR to stitch KV-prefetch + routing-fallback examples into the optimize toolkit docs. PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/4923 :wave:
Maria: Nice, thanks. Can you paste the SDK snippet here so I can sanity-check the param names?
Jamie: Sure — here's the snippet I added to the PR:
```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
resp = client.generate(
    model="rw-opt-7b",
    prompt="Summarize...",
    batching={"max_tokens": 512, "microbatch_size": 8},
    kv_prefetch=True,
    fallback_model="rw-opt-3b-q4"
)
print(resp.text)
```
Sachin: Quick nit — in the SDK the kw is kv_prefetch_policy not kv_prefetch, and fallback_model should be fallback_model_id. Also doc-side we should show the canonical JSON for batching config.
Maria: Good catch. Also add a short note mapping quant profiles -> user expectations (q4 vs q8 memory/perf tradeoffs) and link to /docs/optimize/quant-profiles. I can draft a 2-line sentence.
Jamie: I updated the PR: changed param names, added a 1-line quant mapping, and included a small streaming+batching example. Pinged the infra docs link (https://docs.redwood/inference/optimize/quant-profiles).
Docs Bot: docs-ci / build #3912 — succeeded :white_check_mark:
Alex: I'll review this afternoon. If CI stays green I'll approve. Can you add a tiny note under 'migration checklist' about how to handle pinned model variants?
Jamie: Done — migration checklist in PR description now has the pinned-variant step and a sample command: `rwctl rollout pin --model rw-opt-7b@v3`.
Maria: LGTM after I add one inline comment about the batching JSON example (microbatch->batch_size). Will push that quick edit.
Sachin: One more idea — include a short before/after perf table for an example workload (short chat queries) to show KV-prefetch impact. Even a tiny two-row table helps readers.
Jamie: Good idea, I'll add a 2-row table with p50/p95 for sample app. Thanks all — ping me if you want changes, otherwise I'll merge once Alex approves. :thumbsup:
